title: DocumentInstance
description: The `--instance` payload for `model eval` / `model compute` / `rule eval`: a filled document INSTANCE (the data to evaluate), NOT the model. One object with a single key `fields`, holding a tree that mirrors the model's group/field structure: a non-repeatable group = a nested object keyed by child name; a repeatable group = an ARRAY of row objects; a field = its value as a STRING ("" or null = present-but-unfilled; an absent key = no instance for that field). Encode dates as ISO "YYYY-MM-DD", numbers/enums as their string form. Discover the model's structure with `model describe`.

fields.description: the instance tree, keyed by top-level group name (e.g. "Order"); nest groups/rows/values per the rules above
